messages:
maya: heads up — saw a repro of outputs collapsing to zeros on long sequences when paged-attn + fp16 is used on A100. minimal repro attached below.

maya: repro (very short):
```
# run on a100, fp16, paged-attn
runtest --model redwood/open-7b --seq 4096 --batch 1 --dtype fp16 --attn paged --kv-caching on
```

maya: symptoms: after ~600 tokens the logits become extremely negative and final tokens are all pad/</s>-like. bf16 run on same hardware didn't show the collapse.

liam: do you have kernel timings / max logit stats? could be softmax underflow or exp overflow due to scale.

maya: attaching quick profiler dump (summarized).

anika: paste of perf snippet:
```
[profile] kernel paged_attn_fp16: avg 1.9ms, p95 9.8ms, p99 28.1ms
[profile] flashx_fp16: avg 2.1ms, p95 3.0ms
[max] qk_max before softmax: -1230.2  (huge negative)
[trace] kv-cache warmup: first 8 steps fine, then spike in qk_max variance
```

anika: we also logged softmax inputs — they go to -1200..-3000 which makes exp(x) underflow to 0 in fp16. bf16 values stay at -5..+10 in same prompts.

liam: that suggests the reduction/accumulation path in paged-attn fp16 is losing dynamic range. possible race with prefix sum or wrong scale when merging pages.

maya: interestingly, if we force prefix caching disabled the issue doesn't show. so something about kv merge or the tiled reduction across pages.

anika: tried a quick patch: apply a numeric clamp before exp: softmax_input = max(x - max(x), -50.0) then compute exp. stops the collapse but changes output distribution slightly.

maya: mhm. clamp is a bandaid. we need to understand why qk_max is that large in the first place for fp16 only. could be an accumulation in fp16 during partial reductions.

liam: do we run any fused-reduction kernels in paged path that use fp16 accum? search shows tiled_sum uses half accum in paged_attn kernel for perf. switching accum->float32 might fix numerics but cost perf.

maya: can we reproduce with a small synthetic that isolates tiled summation? i can try to build a microbench.

anika: i ran micro: when seq>2048 and pages>1 the per-page dot product uses per-page scaling and then an inter-page combine in fp16. the inter-page combine shows rounding to -inf in some lanes.

liam: ok that points at accumulation precision. two ways: 1) do fp32 accumulation in the inter-page reduce, 2) insert a per-page rescale (subtract max) earlier so values are bounded, 3) fallback to flash variant for long seq.

maya: preference: make a safe fallback policy in kernel-selector first (low-risk) + an opt-in fp32-accum experiment for paged. fallback should trigger when: dtype==fp16 && seq>2048 && kv-pages>1 && qk_max_stddev>threshold.

anika: i can prototype a flag --paged-accum-fp32 that casts accumulation to float32 for inter-page add. perf hit ~8-12% on microbench but fixes numerics. also bf16 path unchanged.

liam: good. also add a telemetry metric when softmax input max < -100 so we can track how often this happens in prod.

maya: agreed. i'll open an issue and add a short test in ops/attn/tests/regressions that runs the failing prompt across dtype variants.

maya: issue: https://redwood-internal/issue/INF-4721 (assigned to eng-runtime) — includes repro, profiler, suggested fixes.

anika: quick note: fp8 experiments show overflow in the opposite direction (very large positive logits) for some prompts — different bug but we should gate fp8 for paged-attn until we have stable accum semantics.

liam: yeah keep fp8 disabled for paged until we have robust scaling. make sure Optimize recommendations don't suggest fp8 for long sequences.

perf-bot: perf alert: canary patch to kernel-selector rolled out to 10% of hosts (tag: paged-fp32-accum-probe).

maya: thanks. i'll monitor evals and results. initial canary logs show no collapses in patched hosts.

anika: also adding unit that injects extreme qk ranges to the CI attn fuzzer so we catch regressions earlier.

liam: follow-ups: (1) kernel-selector fallback rule, (2) fp32 inter-page accum opt-in, (3) softmax-input telemetry + CI fuzz test, (4) update Optimize to avoid fp8/paged combos.

maya: putting those in the issue checklist. thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary promotion: paged-fp32-accum-probe -> canary(10%) -> monitors enabled

maya: will post results in a few hours after more traces come in.
